source: trends.pinterest.com prefix_match (US, 52 weekly relative counts; last = current week)

summary.med school: avg 51, steady all year, peak late Aug/Sep
summary.application long tails: 'med school application', 'residency application', 'secondary essays' have little Pinterest volume of their own: target the broad terms in titles and put the specific phrase in descriptions

takeaway: Pinterest demand is in broad med-student life and study terms; application posts convert to the Etsy trackers. Mix both: about half life/study, half applying.
